items.title: A basis for a complement of one filtration layer of the Askey-Wilson algebra in the next, built from Omega powers
items.author: Paul Terwilliger
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma exhibits a basis for a complement of the layer Delta_{n-1} inside Delta_n of the filtered algebra, namely the monomials in which the power of Omega appears instead of the compensated combination of A, B, C (statement lines 1658-1671). The proof compares the new family with the known monomial complement basis: it matches the two index sets by an explicit bijection, and then uses two cited lemmas to move each Omega-power element to the matching monomial modulo Delta_{n-1}, collecting the numerical factor q^{ell(2j+ell)} on the way (proof lines 1674-1712). The content is in the comparison, since the two families have different sizes of index sets and the bijection plus the two congruences are what transfer basisness; the final sentence then invokes the known complement basis. Both cited inputs are consumed inside the span, so H2.
